text: Photography is an art form that captures moments in time using cameras to transform light into images. At its core, photography involves capturing images through the lens of a camera, which works by controlling the amount of light that enters and hits the film or sensor. One critical element in the camera's operation is the aperture, which controls the opening through which light passes. By adjusting the aperture, photographers can determine the amount of light that reaches the camera sensor, thereby controlling the exposure of the image. Once the aperture is set, the shutter mechanism is used to capture the image, and the final result is the photograph, which can evoke emotion and tell a story.
